content: ![Alt text](https://imgur.com/sWhGgHc.png) # Hopo Better Mineshafts「15 種礦坑類型」 # [![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/hopo-better-mineshaft?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/hopo-better-mineshaft) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/949138580415062017?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord)](https://discord.gg/CZQthZJjPc) **💎 搭配此資料包使用，礦坑體驗已全面升級，內容更豐富，盡情探索吧！** ✨ 原版礦坑已經相當完善了，因此我並未更動它們。相反地，我新增了全新的礦坑類型，前往深板岩層探索，準備迎接全新的地下挑戰吧！ 🧨 新增了大量主題房間，讓你永遠都有新景點可看，絕不無聊。 🎨 超過 10 種類型，每種都有獨特之處。部分礦坑可能含有比其他礦坑更多的礦石，甚至還有怪物出沒…… ![Alt text](https://imgur.com/LQXHEUd.png) ![Alt text](https://imgur.com/DycIqbn.png) ![Alt text](https://imgur.com/1gTe61a.png) ### 如果你想展開一場冒險，結帳時輸入代碼 'HOPONO' 即可享有首月 25% 折扣優惠！❤️ ### https://bisecthosting.com/hopono [![Discord](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/social/discord-plural_64h.png)](https://discord.gg/CZQthZJjPc) [![CurseForge](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/curseforge_64h.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/hopo-better-mineshaft) [](https://modrinth.com/datapack/hopo-better-mineshaft) [](https://ko-fi.com/hoponopono) ![Alt text](https://imgur.com/lNhcvC4.png)
